date_text: Thu, Jul 9th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jul 12th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: This weekend, Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop is turning Grifter green with 12 taps dedicated to one of Sydney’s favourite independent breweries. From Thursday, we’ll be pouring everything from Grifter’s iconic core range through to a stack of limited and seasonal releases. Expect favourites like Grifter Pale, Lager, XPA, Serpent’s Kiss and The Omen Nitro Stout, alongside limited releases including Faraway IPA, Marnie’s Majority IPA, Frosty Fresh Wet Hop XPA, Old Panther Black Lager, Katipō NZ Pilsner, Big Sur West Coast IPA and the refreshing Pink Galah Sour. Whether you’re chasing a crisp lager, a juicy XPA, a hop-forward IPA, a smooth nitro stout or something a little left of centre, there’s a tap waiting for you. Tap List:- Grifter Pale - 5% Grifter Lager - 4.5% Grifter XPA - 4.4% Serpents Kiss - 4.5% The Omen - 5.5% Nitro Faraway IPA - 6.4% Marnies Majority Ale (IPA) - 6.7% Frosty Fresh Wet Hop XPA - 4.2% Old Panther Black Lager - 4.6% Katipō NZ Pilsner - 5.2% Big Sur WCIPA - 6.7% Pink Galah Sour - 4.7%
